hypothesis: Perovskite-based DSSCs with solid-state electrolytes will exhibit improved stability and efficiency
prediction: Efficiency of perovskite-based DSSCs with solid-state electrolytes will exceed 15%
measurement_method: Current-voltage (I-V) characterization under standard test conditions
falsification_condition: If the average efficiency of perovskite-based DSSCs with solid-state electrolytes, measured over 10 devices, is less than 12% after 100 hours of continuous operation under 1 sun illumination
